title: Almost Invention Workshop Story Evidence Card
evidenceSkill: Use story claim, first clue, second clue, because line, evidence sentence, and bookend note language to support a fictional Almost Invention Workshop idea.
useCase: Adult-led fictional offline paper-only evidence card for an invented workshop story about a nearly working gadget and two clue details: ____________________.
adultSetup: Adult-led fictional offline paper-only setup: place this card, a pencil, and two blank paper part tags beside a pretend workshop sketch: ____________________.
kidDirection: Fill the blanks for a made-up Almost Invention Workshop story; use invented clues only and keep the story calm: ____________________.
storyClaimPrompt: story claim: The almost invention works best when the maker learns ____________________.
firstCluePrompt: first clue: What workshop detail first supports the story claim, such as a wobbling gear, folded lever, or loose paper spring: ____________________.
secondCluePrompt: second clue: What later detail supports the same story claim from a different angle: ____________________.
becauseLinePrompt: because line: These two clues support the story claim because ____________________.
evidenceSentencePrompt: evidence sentence: Write one evidence sentence that uses the first clue and second clue to support the story claim: ____________________.
bookendNotePrompt: bookend note: End the card by restating the story claim in a shorter workshop note: ____________________.
quietOptionLine: quiet option: Fill only the story claim and first clue first, then add the because line later: ____________________.
takeHomeLine: take-home line: Save the paper card and add one new workshop clue on a blank slip later: ____________________.
